dependencies.required_evidence: One terminal q1 full-corpus A receipt and its passing independent soft-pressure verification.
One clean-build terminal q1 full-corpus B receipt and its passing independent soft-pressure verification.
The sealed opening-100M identity/resource receipt and its independently rederived terminal pass.
A byte-zero parent/q1 observer receipt and independent verification of every post-head probability plus seven coder and mutation-scoped state checkpoints in modeled-stream coordinates.
A raw Geekbench 5 report plus exact-package compression/decompression guard-v3 receipts whose wall limits are mechanically derived from that score.
A complete dependency-closure manifest whose counted tree exactly contains the A/B-identical package and passes the OSI license audit.

contract.supersession_reason: Policy v2 bound a phase-11 schema that confused raw corpus bytes with post-preprocessing modeled bytes and had no executable full observer arm or coordinator. V3 preserves v2 for already frozen proposal provenance and replaces future qualification authority with the corrected seven-checkpoint implementation.
mechanical_derivation: The v2 qualification receipt format remains a nine-artifact router and contains no qualification decisions.
The verifier rejects symlinks, multi-link evidence, project-root escapes, byte-count drift, and SHA-256 drift before interpreting evidence.
A/B terminal status, inverse, package, payload, archive, resource, and independent-verification fields are reopened from retained receipts.
The A/B, seven-checkpoint full-identity, and runtime independent verifiers are rerun during consolidation; recomputed outputs must equal supplied verification receipts.
Package bytes, required-option bytes, counted score, target distance, RSS maximum, cgroup maximum, and runtime limit are rederived rather than copied.
A pass grants only memory_safe_external_parent_only authority and always grants zero Gamma compression and score credit.

activation_requirements: The current qm8 diagnostic arm is terminal and independently classified.
Both full A and B arms are terminal passes with clean scratch, cgroup, and lease cleanup.
The opening-100M identity/resource gate and its observer calibration are independently verified terminal passes.
Phase 11's parent and q1 full observer arms and joint independent verification are terminal passes.
The current host has a retained raw Geekbench 5 result and two exact-package prize-facing runtime guards.
The dependency closure exactly covers the counted package and passes the license audit.
The exclusive full-1G lease and acquisition lock are absent when consolidation executes.
claim_boundary: This policy is frozen design and grants no present qualification authority.
A future passing v2-format verification under this v3 policy may authorize q1 only as an external memory-safe experimental parent.
It does not prove compression improvement, Gamma authorship, official verification, or progress against the 105,000,000-byte target.
